entities.summary: Epsilon Tauri b, formally named Amateru, is a super-Jupiter exoplanet orbiting the K-type giant star Epsilon Tauri approximately 146 light-years away from the Earth in the constellation of Taurus. It orbits the star further out than Earth orbits the Sun. It has moderate eccentricity.
